```bash

  -e MACA_PERF_DIR=/tmp -u 0 \
  --device=/dev/dri --device=/dev/mxcd --group-add video \

  harbor.sh.mxcr.io/xshi/esm3-maca@sha256:100959d4b6052578ccc9afef76886e239db1598a7c0aa53b01f9815709212897 \
  -c 'cd /workspace/tests/ESMC && bash /workspace/tests/ESMC/test_esmc.sh && cat /tmp/perf'
```
